slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are salmon, beef, and pork available as selectable foods for this dinner, or should the selection be limited to the four fiber-containing vegetables (okra, carrots, celery, cabbage)?
slot_scores.rationale: The question touches whether proteins are selectable at all, but it does not explicitly ask whether exactly one protein must be chosen or whether multiple proteins can be combined.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about the minimum number of vegetable types; it only mentioned vegetables as an alternative to selecting proteins.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden selection rules were not explicitly asked or confirmed by the agent; H1 was only partially touched and H2 was not asked.

summary: The agent clarified several useful boundary facts, but it did not explicitly ask the two hidden selection rules. It relied on the user simulator volunteering the exactly-one-protein and at-least-two-vegetables requirements, then treated them as confirmed in READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
